name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-annual-processes-year-wheel
title: Annual Processes Year Wheel
shortDescription: Builds an animated D3.js year wheel dashboard that reads a SharePoint list of annual processes live, showing what runs when, who owns it, and what is coming up next.
longDescription: Turns a SharePoint list of recurring annual processes into an interactive year wheel: one ring per department, one arc per process from start month to end month, a today line, filters, KPI cards, a Next up strip, a details panel, and a monthly workload chart.

Own-data mode maps the columns of an existing list and reports data gaps without changing the data. Demo mode creates an Annual Processes list and seeds 30 rows for a fictional company, Northwind Outfitters.
The package includes a canonical HTML template that the agent copies verbatim so the layout, colors, and animations stay consistent. Live pages load D3 v7 through the page's library manifest.
